《Small Prophets》first two episodes are now available on Apple TV+, and have already received glowing reviews as a British comedy series. Watch the trailer below.

《Small Prophets》is now available on Apple TV+

Earlier this morning, my colleague Ryan already reported on the rave reviews for 《Small Prophets》, a British comedy series that was acquired by Apple TV+ earlier this year for international distribution.

This marks the first time Apple TV+ has acquired an English-language series that has already aired elsewhere for the international market.

《Small Prophets》originally premiered earlier this year on BBC iPlayer and BBC Two in the UK, before Apple acquired it for international distribution in August.

Apple TV+ subscribers worldwide — except in the UK — can now watch the series, though UK viewers will have to wait until 2027 for it to arrive on the platform.

《Small Prophets》is created, written, and directed by Mackenzie Crook of 《Detectorists》, who also stars alongside Pearce Quigley (《The Way Back》), Lauren Patel (《The Effects of Lying》), Sir Michael Palin (《Monty Python》), Sophie Willan (《Ludwig》), Jon Pointing (《Big Boys》), and Paul Kaye (《Game of Thrones》), among others.

With the first two episodes now available, the series will release new episodes every Wednesday through November 4.

Here is the synopsis for 《Small Prophets》provided by Apple TV+:

《Small Prophets》tells the comic story of the eccentric Michael Sleep (Pearce Quigley). Since the disappearance of his beloved Clea seven years ago, he has been living a quiet life. He works at a hardware store, visits his father Brian (Sir Michael Palin), and holds out hope that Clea will one day return. One day, Brian shares a secret recipe made of rainwater, horse manure, and a touch of alchemy. Armed with the recipe and a healthy dose of skepticism, Michael sets out to create a "homunculus" — a magical spirit capable of foretelling the future — hoping to find the answer to the question he most wants answered: "Will I ever see Clea again?" With the help of his young colleague Kacey (Lauren Patel), an unexpected friendship develops, based in part (though not entirely) on their shared disdain for branch manager Gordon (Mackenzie Crook). Their friendship, in turn, only serves to further irritate a group of nosy neighbors (Sophie Willan, Jon Pointing) who are dying to know just what on earth is going on inside that garden shed.

Apple TV+ is available for $14.99 per month, or as part of an Apple One bundle. The platform offers a range of hit series and films, including 《Ted Lasso》, 《Severance》, 《The Studio》, 《The Morning Show》, 《Shrinking》, and 《Silo》.
